newsitem.title: BELGIUM: INSIGHT - Chartists see Belgian Bel-20 lower.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Chartists see Belgian Bel-20 lower.

text.p: Leading Belgian shares are set to continue their down trend in the coming week, with candle charts showing bearish formations, Belgian technical analysts said on Monday.
The Bel-20 Index .BFX was likely to encounter support at 1,840, with first resistance plotted at 1,880.
On Monday at midday, the index was up 3.84 points at 1,851.61. On Friday the Bel-20 closed at 1,855.68, down from 1,871.46 a week earlier.

ECOFIS - Last week the Bel-20 weekly candle graph produced a black candle, which is bearish. Also two bearish windows were made in the daily chart. Last Friday a hammer was made, but the bearish window just above that hammer in principle dominates. The window which made the dumpling top the week before last was not closed. This is also bearish. The hammer may induce some pause to upward reversal in the next days. For the next week we expect, however, the Bel-20 moving sideways to down. (Frank Boll).

GENERALE BANK - The positive sentiment that prevailed in the last few weeks evaporated quickly over the week. We are testing the support level that was established on December 6. The downtrend that was established remains in place, and it is confirmed by trading tools like stochastics. As long as we can stay around these levels, damage remains limited. More crucial would be a further drop below the 1800 level. (Geert Vanderbeke).

CERA - Volatility will be the theme in the days ahead led by Wall Street. The Dow Jones sustained intraday swings of more than 90 points on three of the last five trading days. There is investors' concern that the decline in U.S. markets (stocks rarely go up in a volatile market) will spill over into European markets. On the other hand, European bonds rose late Friday after European ministers meeting in Dublin reached an agreement to deter members of the proposed single European currency from overspending. Stocks could benefit from that. A first support for the Bel-20 is at 1,820 and a second at the psychological important level of 1,800. (Guy Sips).
